ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Goopdate.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "goopdate.dll", a DLL used by googleupdate.exe Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\goopdate\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\"))) AND  NOT (((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\GUM.*") AND process_path = RGX(".*\\\.tmp\\\\Dropbox.*")) AND (ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\GUM.*") AND ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\.tmp\\\\goopdate\\\.dll.*"))))
